scope: AC1021 internally synthesized *ACTIVE VPORT null references only. This extends the previously source-qualified AC1024 synthetic behavior; explicit caller VPORTs, nonzero references, the VPORT string layout and other revisions retain their existing paths.

authority_and_source.spec: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.4.64: background soft pointer, visual style hard pointer, SUN hard owner, followed by named/base UCS hard pointers.
authority_and_source.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 created AC1021 from a scratch ezdxf 1.4.5 single-LINE drawing.
authority_and_source.independent_observation: LibreDWG 0.14 reports VPORT owner (4,1,8), xref (5,0,0), background (4,0,0), visual style (5,0,0), SUN (3,0,0), and named/base UCS (5,0,0). The original generated synthetic AC1021 record used roles 0/0/0 for the three middle nulls.

factorial.method: A scratch archive varied only three synthetic null role assignments and optionally exact-bit VPORT string/footer assembly. Masks 1,2,4 select background/visual style/SUN roles; mask 8 selects exact-bit string/footer. The baseline is byte-identical to the material agent's opt-in graph. ODA 27.1.0 converted all 16 locally generated files and a producer control with ACAD2007 DXF, recursion 0, audit 1. Diagnostics are based on output files, not exit status.
factorial.results: Only masks 7 and 15 produce a DXF without .err; all other masks fail at VPORT with no DXF. Thus all three observed null-role changes are needed for these samples; exact-bit VPORT string framing is not needed and is not changed.
factorial.material_prerequisite: With the same three VPORT roles but no default material graph, a default graph DWG 7dbcb968ba3f0a044564cfeb344386ef95b33378da49901152e08f3ae0763875 and a plotstyle-only DWG c0325aa43f755b5254edc695c18e2d42f8c2fe123cc1e45541449c695244a005 still fail at LAYER and emit no DXF.

final_production.oda: Final opt-in material+plotstyle drawing and producer control both produce DXF, with no .err and zero-byte captured stdout/stderr. ezdxf 1.4.5 reports a single LINE (1,2,3) to (4,5,6) on layer 0, *ACTIVE VPORT and layer 0 pointing to Global material. VPORT height, center, grid spacing and snap spacing match LibreDWG's corresponding DWG values in both controls. ODA assigns nonzero DXF visual-style handles despite the source DWG null slots; no cross-format null-preservation claim is made. Output metadata can vary, so the listed DXF hash binds this run only.
final_production.peer: LibreDWG 0.14 confirms the seven VPORT owner/reference roles, following LINE, and the generated default material dictionary/object/header/layer graph. tools/audit_ac1021_vport_roles.py SHA-checks the producer or generated DWG, inspects LibreDWG JSON and verifies the selected DXF fields with ezdxf; the DXF association is the recorded scratch ODA conversion, not an automatically authenticated provenance join. tests/dwg_default_material_libredwg.py independently checks the generated material graph.

validation.result: 6/6 passed in a coherent shared build, and 6/6 passed again atop AC1021 material prerequisite commit f01c05d8.
validation.coverage: Six-version synthetic exact null-role bytes; caller public encoding unchanged; nonzero background/visual-style/SUN and following UCS roles; invalid caller record refusal and corrected same-writer retry; native readback with following LINE.
validation.addressSanitizer: ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R '^libdxfrw_dwg_header_writer_sealing$' --output-on-failure: 1/1 passed after rebuilding the final VPORT candidate with AddressSanitizer.

limits: Warning-free conversion is established only for the sampled synthetic AC1021 material+plotstyle drawing and ODA 27.1.0 on this host, not arbitrary drawings, native editing, visual rendering or complete semantic parity.
The material graph is the separately validated prerequisite in commit f01c05d8.
